  <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
    <Sequence name="main_mission">

      <!-- Phase 1: Navigate to vending_machine, stop immediately if person detected,
           wait for them to leave, wait 10s, then resume -->
      <RetryUntilSuccessful num_attempts="1000">
        <Fallback name="nav_or_handle_person">

          <!-- Navigate to vending_machine; abort the instant a person is detected -->
          <ReactiveSequence name="nav_with_person_check">
            <Inverter>
              <CheckDetection name="watch_for_person" class_name="person" min_confidence="0.5" max_age="2.0"/>
            </Inverter>
            <NavigateToLocation name="go_to_vending" location="vending_machine"/>
          </ReactiveSequence>

          <!-- Person was detected: wait until they leave, wait 10s, then force retry -->
          <ForceFailure>
            <Sequence name="handle_person_detected">
              <!-- Block until person leaves the frame -->
              <ReactiveFallback name="wait_for_person_gone">
                <Inverter>
                  <CheckDetection name="check_person_present" class_name="person" min_confidence="0.5" max_age="2.0"/>
                </Inverter>
                <KeepRunningUntilFailure>
                  <Wait name="poll_wait" wait_duration="0.5"/>
                </KeepRunningUntilFailure>
              </ReactiveFallback>
              <!-- Wait 10 seconds before resuming -->
              <Wait name="wait_10s" wait_duration="10.0"/>
            </Sequence>
          </ForceFailure>

        </Fallback>
      </RetryUntilSuccessful>

      <!-- Phase 2: Return to [lab] entrance -->
      <NavigateToLocation name="return_to_[lab]" location="[lab]_entrance"/>

    </Sequence>
  </BehaviorTree>

        <Fallback name="try_3_times">

          <!-- Attempt 1 -->

          <Sequence name="recover_and_retry_from_1">
            <BackUp name="backup_1" backup_dist="0.5" backup_speed="0.1"/>
            <Wait name="wait_1" wait_duration="5.0"/>

            <Fallback name="try_2_and_3">

              <NavigateToLocation name="nav_elevator_2" location="elevator"/>

                <BackUp name="backup_2" backup_dist="0.5" backup_speed="0.1"/>
                <Wait name="wait_2" wait_duration="5.0"/>

                <!-- Attempt 3 (last); success or failure both caught by ForceSuccess above -->
                <NavigateToLocation name="nav_elevator_3" location="elevator"/>
              </Sequence>

            </Fallback>
          </Sequence>

        </Fallback>
      </ForceSuccess>

      <!-- Always return to [lab] entrance after all attempts -->
      <NavigateToLocation name="return_home" location="[lab]_entrance"/>

<root BTCPP_format="4">
  <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
    <KeepRunningUntilFailure name="infinite_greeter_loop">
      <Sequence name="greeter_cycle">

        <!-- Step 1: Go to [lab] entrance to begin/restart the greeting cycle -->
        <NavigateToLocation name="go_to_[lab]" location="[lab]_entrance"/>

        <!-- Step 2: Wait up to 60 s for a person.
             If timeout fires (FAILURE), fall through to panning loop. -->
        <Fallback name="detect_person">
          <WaitForDetection name="wait_60s" class_name="person" min_confidence="0.5" timeout="60.0"/>
          <!-- Pan back and forth slowly until a person is spotted -->
          <ReactiveFallback name="pan_until_person">
            <CheckDetection name="check_person_during_pan" class_name="person" min_confidence="0.5" max_age="2.0"/>
            <KeepRunningUntilFailure name="keep_panning">
              <Spin name="pan_sweep" target_yaw="3.14" time_allowance="15.0"/>
            </KeepRunningUntilFailure>
          </ReactiveFallback>
        </Fallback>

        <!-- Step 3: Face person, drive 1 m forward, wait 5 s.
             Wrapped in Fallback so a lost detection lets the cycle continue. -->
        <Fallback name="greet_or_continue">
          <Sequence name="greeting">
            <HeadingController name="face_person" class_name="person" detection_loss_timeout="2.0"/>
            <MoveForward name="approach_1m" forward_dist="1.0"/>
            <Wait name="greet_pause" wait_duration="5.0"/>
          </Sequence>
          <AlwaysSuccess/>
        </Fallback>

        <!-- Steps 4–5: Route to vending machine, then kitchen entrance -->
        <NavigateToLocation name="go_to_vending" location="vending_machine"/>
        <NavigateToLocation name="go_to_kitchen" location="kitchen_entrance"/>

        <!-- Sequence SUCCESS → KRUF converts to RUNNING → restarts from [lab]_entrance -->
